Flutter Symbol AOT fixture
==========================

The fixture is a benign source-authored Dart program compiled without execution.

Toolchain
---------

Flutter 3.44.6 stable, framework revision ee80f08bbf, engine d3a3293399556a85388faf8c6f0723a7a5597aa8, Dart 3.12.2.

Dart SDK annotated tag 3.12.2 has tag object 704629bcd35e8bc1dd6b4808b618cccbbbd8fb6a and resolves to commit d684a576a6aa954ae107a03b2b4e1d61c3bebe93. At that revision, sdk/lib/internal/symbol.dart defines the concrete dart:_internal.Symbol with one final String field named _name. runtime/vm/app_snapshot.cc serializes ordinary Instance pointer fields through the generic instance cluster.

Build
-----

Run from this directory with DART set to Flutter's bin/cache/dart-sdk directory and ENGINE set to Flutter's bin/cache/artifacts/engine/android-arm64-release/windows-x64 directory.

    DART/bin/dartaotruntime.exe DART/bin/snapshots/gen_kernel_aot.dart.snapshot --platform DART/lib/_internal/vm_platform_strong.dill --no-link-platform --filesystem-root=. --filesystem-scheme=disrobe-fixture -o symbol_probe.app.dill disrobe-fixture:///symbol_probe.dart
    DART/bin/dartaotruntime.exe DART/bin/snapshots/gen_kernel_aot.dart.snapshot --platform DART/lib/_internal/vm_platform_strong.dill --aot --filesystem-root=. --filesystem-scheme=disrobe-fixture -o symbol_probe.aot.dill disrobe-fixture:///symbol_probe.dart
    ENGINE/gen_snapshot.exe --snapshot_kind=app-aot-elf --elf=symbol_probe_arm64.so symbol_probe.aot.dill

The disrobe-fixture URI scheme prevents host and worktree paths from entering either artifact. The intermediate symbol_probe.aot.dill is not committed. The test parses the committed app-only kernel as the independent source witness and the Android ARM64 product ELF through the public recovery path.
